create_VOC2007_dataset: create a VOC2007 PyTorch dataset from a PASCAL VOC directory with train or val split
build_VOC2007_with_transform: build a VOC2007 dataset with an optional image transform applied to each loaded image
test_VOC2007_getitem: test the VOC2007 dataset getitem method to return an RGB image and its 20-class label array
review_VOC2007_label_mapping: review the VOC2007 dataset label mapping that swaps ignore and not-present labels for 20 classes
summarize_VOC2007_dataset_class: summarize the VOC2007_dataset class that loads PASCAL VOC images and per-class presence labels from ImageSets
